issue.title: [aw] Issue Triage (skills-driven) could not verify daily AI credits
issue.body:
### Workflow Failure

**Workflow:** [Issue Triage (skills-driven)](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/.github/workflows/issue-triage.md)  
**Branch:** trunk  
**Run:** https://github.com/cli/cli/actions/runs/40531178490


> [!WARNING]
> **Daily Workflow AI Credits Could Not Be Verified**: The agent was not started because the daily guardrail could not prove complete AI Credits accounting for earlier workflow runs.

**Guardrail status:** `transient_error`

**Reason:** Daily workflow AI Credits are unknown: Server Error

The guardrail fails closed either because a billable component's usage artifact is missing, empty, or unreadable, or because the guardrail could not reach the GitHub API to verify prior runs. The detailed reason above identifies the specific cause.

This is typically a transient GitHub API failure, such as a network error or rate limiting. The guardrail will retry automatically on the next run; no action is required unless the failures persist.


### Action Required

**Assign this issue to an agent** to debug and fix the issue.

<summary>Debug with any coding agent</summary>

Use this prompt with any coding agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, etc.):

````

The failed workflow run is at https://github.com/cli/cli/actions/runs/40531178490
````

</details>
